modules.name: Registration and Consent
modules.description: Registration screens that show the consent screen and privacy notice and collect the neighbour-visibility choice.

modules.name: Complaint Records
modules.description: Complaint handling that carries the Builder Responsibility tag and keeps complaint records with photos.

modules.name: Family Member Data
modules.description: Storage of family members' names and ages, including children, under the DPDP Act.

modules.name: Neighbours List
modules.description: Display of a resident's name and occupation to neighbours, based on consent.

modules.name: OTP Login
modules.description: Login by OTP sent through SMS under TRAI DLT rules.

requirements.title: Consent screen and privacy notice at registration
requirements.description: The system must show a consent screen and a privacy notice at registration, as the DPDP Act requires.

requirements.title: User deletion requests
requirements.description: Users must be able to ask for deletion of their data.

requirements.title: Breach notification
requirements.description: The system must support informing users and the authority of a data breach.

requirements.title: Builder Responsibility tag
requirements.description: Complaints must be taggable with a Builder Responsibility tag to support RERA defect responsibility.

requirements.title: Complaint record with photos
requirements.description: A full complaint record with photos must be kept as proof of action.

requirements.title: Register SMS sender ID and templates
requirements.description: The sender ID and SMS templates must be registered under TRAI DLT before launch so OTP SMS is not blocked.

requirements.title: Consent from head of family
requirements.description: Consent must be collected from the head of family when members are added.

requirements.title: Log member list downloads
requirements.description: Every download of the member list must be logged.

requirements.title: Remove member data when family leaves
requirements.description: Members' data must be removed when a family leaves, after the retention period.

requirements.title: Show me to neighbours choice
requirements.description: Registration must ask for consent with a clear "Show me to neighbours" choice.

requirements.title: Change neighbour visibility in Profile
requirements.description: Users must be able to change their neighbour-visibility choice anytime in Profile.

rules.title: Collect only needed data
rules.description: Only the data that is needed may be collected, as per the DPDP Act.

rules.title: Delete visitor data after 90 days
rules.description: Visitor data is deleted after 90 days (to be confirmed).

rules.title: Keep complaint records at least 5 years
rules.description: Complaint records with photos must be kept for at least 5 years, matching the RERA defect responsibility period.

rules.title: Store birth year only
rules.description: For family members, only the birth year is stored, not the full birth date.

rules.title: Children's details restricted
rules.description: Children's details are shown only to the Society Manager and Raghuvir Admin.

rules.title: Neighbour listing needs consent
rules.description: A person's name and occupation may be shown to neighbours only with that person's consent.
